what: While a full-height section stays pinned for its own height, the 610×325 video window in the center (phone 140×220) grows 20px larger than the screen. At step 1.5 the text rises from half a screen below, at step 3 it vanishes 50px upward, and at step 3.5 the video blurs by 10px while a video window (YouTube slot) rises over it from 100px below — each step is length 1 (phone .5), GSAP default curve, scrub 1. A promo video section where the street video seen in a small window becomes the full screen and the main video appears on top

options.w · h: Fully grown window size, default calc(100vw + 20px) · calc(100vh + 20px)
options.--fx-w · --fx-h · --fx-w-narrow · --fx-h: Initial window size (via style), default 38.125rem · 20.3125rem · phone 8.75rem · 13.75rem
options.step · step-narrow · narrow: Step size and narrow-screen breakpoint (px), default 1 · .5 · 768
options.text-in · text-out · full-in: Step slots for text entering·leaving·video window rising, default 1.5 · 3 · 3.5
options.rise: Distance text rises when it disappears (px), default 50
options.scrub: Seconds to lag behind scroll, default 1
options.end: Fixed end (ScrollTrigger end), default bottom top — pinned for the section height
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Text that fades in and out over the video (multiple allowed)
options.[data-fx-part=full]: Panel that rises last (video window · buttons)
